out_of_scope: S07 judge_ambiguous_match and S13 triage_beneficiary_bank_reply: a person decides
S09 approve_four_eyes: stays with a person
phone calls and any work off the desktop

hitl_gates.reason: workers override it in 23% of runs; 159 characters of free text per run

four_eyes.rule: Stays with a person who did not draft the correction; the agent only prepares what the approver reads.

controls.kill_switch: One flag per step in the pack, read before every action. When it is off the step returns to the manual queue. The trip and return rules are designed in 25 KillSwitch.
controls.audit: Every read and write is logged with case id, step id, run id and the pseudonymous id of the approving person. Free text from case records is not stored in the log.

acceptance.metric: field agreement with the worker's saved result, shadow mode
acceptance.how_measured: Run beside workers on golden cases and compare field by field.

acceptance.metric: escalations to a person per 100 cases
acceptance.how_measured: Count runs the agent hands back, from the agent's own audit log.

acceptance.metric: touch-time share removed on the pack's steps
acceptance.how_measured: Task-mining touch time on the same step labels, before and after rollout.

fault_injections: a transposed character in the beneficiary name
a closed account returned by the lookup
a timeout from the payments hub
a missing field in the original payment

stages: shadow: agent runs, workers keep working
supervised: agent acts on a sample, worker audits
scoped autonomy: agent acts, worker audits exceptions
exit_criteria: A1 met on the golden cases
A1 met on the shadow-mode cases
no A4 finding in two weeks

runbook_items: read the audit log for a case
return the step to the manual queue
monitoring: touch minutes per case on the pack's steps

estimate.assumption: An agent removes 70% of a step's touch time (modeled, not measured). Hours are touch hours in the 30 days of data.
